explanation: Composer M. M. Keeravani accepted the award in 2023. An earlier Oscar-winning song by an Indian composer, A. R. Rahman's 'Jai Ho', came from the British film Slumdog Millionaire (2008).

claims.text: The song 'Naatu Naatu' from the Telugu-language film RRR (2022) won the Academy Award for Best Original Song.
Baahubali: The Beginning, Pushpa: The Rise and Eega did not win an Oscar.
M. M. Keeravani, the composer of 'Naatu Naatu', accepted the Oscar at the ceremony in March 2023.
A. R. Rahman's 'Jai Ho', from Slumdog Millionaire (2008), won the Academy Award for Best Original Song.
Slumdog Millionaire is a British film.

writerNotes: Self-check 9.3. Lint: clean. Rival test: Baahubali and Eega are the traps: both are Telugu films by RRR's own director, S. S. Rajamouli. Pushpa: The Rise is another Telugu hit of the same years. Volatility: evergreen; no time words; nothing depends on events after mid-2026. Regional: an Indian production; the song title is enough, and no lyrics appear (§3.7). Style: Oxford spelling, straight single quotes, plain hyphens, explanation of 30 words. Myths: claims screened against myths.json; no claim resembles a listed myth. Mystery and encore: not applicable to a practice item. Doubts: the award is a dated fact from 2023, well inside the knowledge horizon; nothing in the item can change.
